India pushes for BRICS tax cooperation

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the BRICS countries' efforts to find common ground on international taxation are significant, particularly as global tax rules are being renegotiated. She urged for stronger cooperation on international taxation among the bloc.
